projectDescription: A cross-platform Rust library providing core functionality for building speedrun timers, with language bindings for C, C#, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Ruby, Python, and JavaScript/WebAssembly.
keyFeatures: Full speedrun timer logic: start, split, pause, reset, undo, skip
Composite splits file parser supporting 15+ formats (LiveSplit, Flitter, Splitterino, WSplit, and more)
Automatic comparison generators: Best Segments, Personal Best, Average Segments, Median Segments, Balanced PB, and more
Modular layout system with 20+ display components (Timer, Splits, Delta, Graph, Title, etc.)
Real Time and Game Time support with loading time tracking
Auto Splitting runtime via WebAssembly modules with game memory access
Global hotkey system supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, and web
Software and SVG renderers for CPU-based layout rendering
C API with auto-generated language bindings for C, C#, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Ruby, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/WebAssembly
no_std compatible for embedded and constrained environments
publicApiSurface: Timer::start() / split() / split_or_start() / reset(update_splits) / pause() / resume()
SoftwareRenderer::new() / render(layout_state, image_cache, buffer, size, stride, is_dark)
comparison generators: BestSegments, BalancedPB, AverageSegments, MedianSegments, WorstSegments
analysis: current_pace, delta, pb_chance, possible_time_save, sum_of_segments, total_playtime
components: Timer, Splits, Title, Delta, Graph, PbChance, PossibleTimeSave, SumOfBest, DetailedTimer, Text, Carousel, Group
